recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. Future follow-up should be limited to any specific publisher warnings about untagged conformance verbs, not the section structure corrected here.
issue_request: FHIR-37753 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for the FHIR-core search page. It requested tagging conformance statements in page text and auto-generating a Conformance Summary from those tagged statements, with publisher/tooling support for fhir-conformance spans and a conformance-statement-summary token.
initial_application: A 2022 mock-up added a #conformancesummary contents link and a manual Conformance Summary table, then the manual table was removed while the contents link remained. In 2025, commit 80f4b1c added the generated summary token and an initial fhir-conformance span, and commit a3766ac tagged the search page conformance statements. The current source had the token and tags, but the token was still under Summary Tables and the #conformancesummary link had no matching anchor.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes record the 2022 deferral concern that a summary table could lack context, and the 2023 final persuasive 4-0-0 vote. The current source/search.html page is the active Search (RESTful API) page linked from source/documentation.html. Targeted Jira and community searches found no later conflicting decision or related issue requiring a separate reconciliation decision.
